game module¶

Game module for Cluedo game.

Contains the Game class which orchestrates the full game lifecycle: setup, card dealing, turn management, suggestion and accusation handling, and end condition checking.

Also defines the module-level card data lists _SUSPECTS, _WEAPONS, and _ROOMS used throughout the game.

class game.Game¶

Bases: object

Orchestrate a full game of Cluedo.

Manages setup, turn order, movement, suggestions, accusations, and end conditions. Maintains shared game state including player list, solution envelope, current positions, and turn index.

Attributes:

board: The Board instance used for movement validation. players: Ordered list of Player objects in turn order. solution: Dict with keys ‘Suspect’, ‘Weapon’, ‘Room’

holding the solution Card objects.

face_up_cards: List of leftover cards visible to all

players after dealing.

current_positions: Dict mapping character name to their

current board position.

_turn_index: Index into players for the current turn. _current_player: The player whose turn is currently

active, used by prompt helpers to show the notesheet.

Public methods:

setup: Run the full pre-game setup sequence. deal_cards: Shuffle and deal cards to players. run: Start and manage the main game loop. play_turn: Execute one full turn for a player. handle_suggestion: Resolve a suggestion in a room. handle_accusation: Resolve a formal accusation. print_summary: Print a summary of the current game state.

deal_cards()¶

Shuffle and deal cards to players, sealing one of each category in the solution envelope.

Shuffle each category independently, pop one card of each type into the solution dict, combine and shuffle the remainder, deal round-robin to players, and set any leftover cards as face-up.

handle_accusation(player: Player) → EndCondition¶

Resolve a formal accusation from player.

Prompts for three cards, checks against the solution, and returns the appropriate EndCondition.

Args:

player: The player making the accusation.

Returns:

CORRECT_ACCUSATION if the guess matches the solution, WRONG_ACCUSATION if not (also eliminates the player), or ALL_ELIMINATED if no active players remain after elimination.

handle_suggestion(player: Player, room: str) → None¶

Resolve a suggestion made by player in room.

Prompt the suggesting player to name a suspect and weapon, move the named suspect token into the room, then check each other player left-to-right for a matching card. Record the shown card in the suggesting player’s notesheet.

Args:

player: The player making the suggestion. room: The room the suggestion is made in, always the

player’s current room.

play_turn(player: Player) → EndCondition | None¶

Execute one full turn for player.

Handles the special case where the player was moved into a room by another player’s suggestion (can_suggest_without_moving), rolling and moving, in-room suggestions, corridor end-of-turn, and Central Room accusations.

Args:

player: The Player whose turn it is.

Returns:

An EndCondition if the game should end, otherwise None.

print_summary(current_player: Player | None = None) → None¶

Print a summary of the current game state.

Shows the board, all player positions and statuses, and — if current_player is provided — that player’s notesheet.

Args:
current_player: The player whose notesheet to display, or None

to skip the notesheet section.

run()¶

Start the main game loop and run until an end condition.

Cycle through active players calling play_turn() until CORRECT_ACCUSATION or ALL_ELIMINATED is returned. Print the solution and result on exit.

setup()¶

Run the full pre-game setup sequence.

Ask for player count, collect names and character choices, place tokens at starting positions, deal cards, record face-up and own-hand cards into each player’s notesheet, and roll dice to determine turn order.
